name: Zhang Yiming

controls.name: ByteDance Ltd. (private; TikTok, Douyin, Doubao AI assistant, Lark)
controls.role: Main co-founder; stepped down as CEO in 2021 and as chairman in Nov 2021
controls.stake: ~21% economic stake (Fortune); over 50% of voting rights (Reuters, Mar 2024)

stakes.name: TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC (US TikTok, CapCut and Lemon8 operations; CEO Adam Presser) — indirect via ByteDance. ByteDance holds 19.9%; Oracle, Silver Lake and MGX 15% each as managing investors; other investors include the Dell family office and affiliates of Susquehanna, General Atlantic and Dragoneer, plus Alpha Wave, Revolution and Xavier Niel's family office

privateDeals.what: ByteDance gave up control of TikTok's US business to a JV of mostly US investors including Oracle and Silver Lake (established Jan 22, 2026)
New valuation marks from BlackRock and Fidelity lifted Zhang's net worth by ~$12B in September 2026; Fortune reported he overtook Gautam Adani as Asia's richest person

TikTok USDS JV established under the 2025-09-25 executive order. Its 7-member board includes Shou Chew, Egon Durban (Silver Lake), Kenneth Glueck (Oracle) and David Scott (MGX). US owners are to lease ByteDance's algorithm, which Oracle will retrain

policy.what: Reuters, citing the WSJ, reported the Trump administration was set to receive a ~$10B fee for brokering the TikTok deal (headline seen via citation; Reuters blocked fetch)

Irish Data Protection Commission fined TikTok €530M (€485M for GDPR Art. 46(1) China data transfers, €45M for transparency) and ordered compliance within 6 months or suspension of transfers to China (decision 2025-04-30, announced 2025-05-02)
DPC opened a new inquiry (July 2025) into TikTok's transfers of EEA users' personal data to servers in China

giving.name: $10M commitment to the Gates Foundation's COVID-19 Therapeutics Accelerator (May 2020; older)

watch.what: ByteDance valuation marks and employee buyback pricing (BlackRock/Fidelity marks drove Sept 2026 jump)
ByteDance AI push: Doubao assistant (345M MAU; China's top AI app in Q1 2026)
TikTok USDS JV governance, algorithm-lease and Oracle retraining; any change to ByteDance's 19.9% stake
Outcome of the DPC's second inquiry into TikTok's EEA-to-China data transfers

gaps: The published profile relied on Wikipedia for the TikTok USDS split and said ByteDance and affiliates keep 50%. The TikTok newsroom says ByteDance itself holds 19.9%; the ~50% figure seems to add in ByteDance's existing investors. The Wikipedia source is retracted and replaced. Still missing: Zhang's personal holding vehicles and ByteDance's 2026 buyback price. Only low-tier reports of a ~$550B valuation were seen, so it was left out.
